AIADMK sends defamation notice to Tamil Nadu minister

The All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK) has issued a defamation notice to Tamil Nadu Minister Nirmal Kumar. The notice seeks ₹1 crore in damages.
